races.verdict: THE QUIET GENT returned from a 10-month absence (gelded during that time) with a solid second starting out for a new yard at Brighton 5 weeks ago and, with fewer miles on the clock than plenty in this field, is given the chance to build on that with first-time cheekpieces now enlisted. Sergeant Pep , Baldomero and the hat-trick seeking Safari Dream head the dangers, along with Tenbob Tommy in a competitive affair. THE QUIET GENT (IRE) SERGEANT PEP (IRE) BALDOMERO (IRE)

races.verdict: TWO COMMANDERS was well served by the return to this trip and looked one to keep on side when doubling his tally at Musselburgh 18 days ago. A 3 lb rise certainly doesn't look insurmountable and he's fancied to follow up from a handy draw. Karl Burke's French recruit Scutari and Dublin Bay are a couple of the chief dangers. TWO COMMANDERS SCUTARI DUBLIN BAY (IRE)

races.display_title: Virgin Bet Daily Extra Places Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict: LADY GORMIRE had been held back by racing too freely but settled better when off the mark under a positive ride at Catterick 16 days ago. She's well drawn to employ the same tactics here and could dominate matters. So Sassy won back-to-back handicaps on all-weather at Wolverhampton recently and is thriving but now switches to turf, whilst Sugar Sugar merits respect if she's in the mood. LADY GORMIRE (IRE) SO SASSY (IRE) SUGAR SUGAR (IRE)

races.verdict: Sammy Jo Bell has a strong record in this race, with 3 wins since 2019, and ANTHROPOLOGIST might be able to provide her with another success. This 4-y-o has raced mainly on all-weather since joining Michael Herrington but won on turf during his time with Charlie Johnston. This trip could be on the limit of Caragio 's stamina but trainer-jockey Adam Kirby might have had this race in mind for him for a while and he's second choice ahead of Wield , the mount of recently retired Joe Fanning. ANTHROPOLOGIST CARAGIO (IRE) WIELD

races.verdict: A wide open finale. FANS FAVOURITE did well to score at Beverley last time and is fancied to rack up a fourth success of 2026 under conditions which really suit and with Oisin Murphy now in the saddle. Almekarem has yet to race on soft going but is weighted to go close on the back of his very good Epsom second so warrants plenty of respect. Last year's victor Something Splendid and in-form duo Everyoneknowsadave and Canvas can also have a say. FANS FAVOURITE ALMEKAREM (IRE) SOMETHING SPLENDID

races.verdict: THE DOTSKI shaped with definite promise in a pair of maiden hurdles during the second half of last season, paying for a big move into contention when fourth in a Navan maiden in February. races.verdict: SHE'LL BE KEPT has been a different proposition since joining her current yard and is taken to defy a further 11 lb rise and complete the hat-trick. The consistent Theflyingbee looks the main danger, while the unexposed Walkingmayotomilan is also one to consider. SHE'LL BE KEPT (IRE) THEFLYINGBEE (IRE) WALKINGMAYOTOMILAN (IRE)

races.verdict: IL SILENZIO has looked a much-improved performer since being sent chasing and did well to overcome a troubled passage when scoring at Roscommon last month. A 7 lb rise doesn’t look excessive and, with more to come, he makes plenty of appeal. Set The Tone shaped well last time and remains well treated on his hurdles form, so rates the main danger, while the progressive Ladies Well is another to consider. IL SILENZIO SET THE TONE (IRE) LADIES WELL (IRE)

races.verdict: LEAVE IN SECRET went like the best horse at the weights when runner-up at Wexford last time, and he may be able to go one better here. Sayitfirst looks interesting on the pick of her chase form, while Lady Doyanne and Stoneyford Lady both appeal for the excellent Henry De Bromhead yard. LEAVE IN SECRET (IRE) SAYITFIRST (IRE) LADY DOYANNE (IRE)
